mapper.select: SELECT a.chat_model_id AS model_id, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.status < 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS success_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.status < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_calls, COALESCE(SUM(cr.input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(cr.output_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens_used, MAX(cr.create_dt) AS last_used_dt FROM sai_agent_conversation_record cr JOIN sai_agent a ON cr.agent_id = a.id WHERE a.chat_model_id IS NOT NULL AND (cr.input_tokens > 0 OR cr.output_tokens > 0) GROUP BY a.chat_model_id

SELECT CAST(cr.create_dt AS DATE) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(cr.input_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cr.output_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens FROM sai_agent_conversation_record cr WHERE CAST(cr.create_dt AS DATE) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY CAST(cr.create_dt AS DATE)
